name: In Fair Spirits
source:
In the distant past, when England was split into various warring factions, Edmund lived a quiet life with his father and his younger sister, Leofe. Edmund wanted nothing more than to protect his sister, and was determined to always be by her side…

But Leofe’s ambitions to become a knight drove a wedge between them, and their relationship crumbled.

Now, almost one thousand years in the future, Edmund has been reincarnated in the small English village of Fenchapel. He is still grappling with his complex feelings about his younger sister, who perished many, many centuries ago…

And he has even more to contend with when he meets a smiley young man called Abel with a mischievous streak.

Talking to Abel initially helps Edmund put his past behind him, but what is he to do when Abel’s smiling façade begins to slip?

There is much more to Abel than one might initially suspect – and, over time, Edmund begins to see in his new companion a kindred soul, born centuries apart from himself, who might be able to understand him.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2622770/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在遥远的过去，当英格兰分裂成各个交战派系时，埃德蒙与父亲和妹妹利奥菲过着平静的生活。艾德蒙一心只想保护妹妹，并决心永远陪伴在她身边……

但利奥夫成为一名骑士的野心使他们之间产生了裂痕，他们的关系破裂了。

现在，差不多一千年后，埃德蒙在英国小村庄芬查佩尔转世。他仍在努力应对对他妹妹的复杂感情，她在许多个世纪前就去世了……

当他遇到一个名叫阿贝尔、脾气暴躁、笑容可掬的年轻人时，他要面对的事情就更多了。

与亚伯交谈最初帮助埃德蒙将过去抛在脑后，但当亚伯的笑容开始消失时，他该怎么办？

亚伯身上的东西比人们最初怀疑的要多得多——随着时间的推移，埃德蒙开始在他的新同伴身上看到一个志同道合的灵魂，他与自己相隔几个世纪，也许能够理解他。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2622770/]Steam[/url]]
